query:
SELECT max(finished_at)::text AS "latest?",
               COALESCE(bool_or(NOT (
                 steps @> '[{"step": "emoji", "outcome": "skipped"}]'
                 OR steps @> '[{"step": "emoji", "outcome": "ok", "summary": {"uploaded": 0}}]'
               )), false) AS "uploaded!"
        FROM refresh_runs
        WHERE finished_at > COALESCE($1::text::timestamptz, '-infinity')
